scope: Local persisted alert history and explicit all-symbol refresh on the frozen isolated candidate; source and helper review plus one independently executed offline probe.
candidate_state: Uncommitted frozen changes reviewed against base; no reviewer source or Git mutations.

strengths.detail: Reuses the existing alerts/alert_events tables without a migration. SELECT-only history validates a strict integer limit of 1..500 and returns symbol, threshold, observed price and bar time.

A bounded heap compares parsed aware datetimes, preserving offset and microsecond ordering; alert ID and timestamp string make ties deterministic. Existing crossing and timestamp suppression code is unchanged.
The new four-column history table is read-only. Construction loads persisted history with require_latest=False and does not call check_alerts.
Manual refresh iterates latest_by_symbol() independently of the selected combo item; every locally recorded symbol is evaluated. Trade validation, cash, holdings and conversion code are unchanged.

Real SQLite and Qt tests cover two-symbol refresh, selection independence, reopen, duplicate and older timestamps, read-only loading and paper-account preservation; tests do not replace the feature with mocks.

findings.title: Row limit does not bound the amount of historical work
findings.detail: alert_history scans and parses all persisted events before retaining the newest limit rows. The result and heap memory are bounded, but refresh/reopen time is O(event count * log(limit)) on the Qt thread.
findings.impact: A large long-lived local history may pause the interface. No incorrect ordering or loss was found, and the current publication helper already discloses the full cursor scan.
findings.recommendation: Keep this explicit limitation for this slice; measure a realistic large-history case before a production-size claim. A future indexed canonical timestamp column would need a deliberate compatibility/migration design.

minor: Row count is bounded; total event scanning time is not.

recommendations: Proceed with the bounded isolated candidate only after root completes rollback/reinstatement, the post-reinstatement targeted gate, publication allowlist checks and exact remote SHA verification.
Retain both initial failed evidence and the corrected author guard attribution; do not present the rejected socket-construction probe as product failure or erase it.
Describe the UI as manual local history, with native/mobile notifications and live feed unaccepted.
Use non-optimized Python for assert-based capture/rollback/publication helpers, ensure no concurrent writer is active, and retain byte-exact backups until final acceptance.

author_targeted.limitation: Recorded evidence was read, not rerun. Audit scope permits socket construction and a recorded ::1:0 capability bind; it is not an OS sandbox.

root_full_regression.limitation: JSON report and verification helper were read; reviewer did not repeat the suite or claim to execute it.

root_ui_capture.limitation: Reviewer read capture code and JSON; root supplied visual inspection. Capture patches Dashboard.refresh and uses offscreen Qt with synthetic bars; this does not prove live-provider, physical-device or full UI acceptance.

result.guard_scope: All Python socket audit events and listed process starts denied before temporary state and project imports; not an OS sandbox

reviewer_probe.purpose: Close the uncovered combined case of persisted event history with zero analysis runs and more than 100 valid crossings. Verify constructor/reopen/refresh remain read-only for alert state and display only the newest 100.
reviewer_probe.limitations: One bounded single-process Qt/SQLite probe; no main-window capture, no full suite, no native device or performance benchmark.

preserved_failure_attribution.author_red: Parent reported 12 red tests: one failure, ten errors and one preexisting behavior pass. Current journal corroborates missing history and selected-symbol-only refresh; reviewer did not execute the red run.
preserved_failure_attribution.initial_green_guard: The preserved initial author green guard failure and diagnosed urllib3 ::1 metadata probe are historical evidence; corrected author PASS is separately attributed.

safety_review.source_effects: New production code reads local SQLite and renders Qt rows; refresh only calls existing local alert evaluation. No notification transport, provider, credential, real-order, payment or email path was added.
safety_review.reviewer_actions: Read isolated candidate, evidence and helper files; read Git metadata/diffs; ran exactly one guarded isolated-state probe; wrote this report. No primary-project access, Git mutation, network request, external message or helper mutation was performed by reviewer.
safety_review.probe_guard: Installed before project imports and temporary state; rejects all Python socket audit events plus listed subprocess/process starts. No denied event occurred; state was confined to TemporaryDirectory and cleaned up.
safety_review.root_guard_limits: verify/capture deny selected audited DNS/connect/sendto/process events before project imports. They permit socket creation/bind; Python audits do not constrain native extension/Qt networking and are not an OS sandbox. Zero denied events is bounded evidence for those audited events only.
safety_review.temporary_state: Root verify uses a task-evidence isolated state path, capture uses TemporaryDirectory, and the reviewer probe uses its own TemporaryDirectory with ANKA_OFFLINE=1.
safety_review.protected_primary: Untouched and unread by reviewer. The reused primary helper compares the known 28 dirty-file hashes, HEAD, branch and status; it does not hash the entire checkout. Root must continue its own protection checks.
safety_review.publication_limits: Publication helper checks frozen hashes, review verdict, test/capture/roundtrip evidence, canonical remote and changed-file allowlist, then scans text for known sensitive patterns. This is useful gating, not exhaustive secret detection or permission to publish. Screenshot content requires human/agent visual inspection. No publication helper was executed by reviewer.
safety_review.helper_assertions: Rollback and publish reject optimized Python; capture relies on asserts without that explicit check, so its caller must use non-optimized Python. Reviewer probe recorded python_optimized=0.

rollback.helper_static_assessment: No blocking issue found for the explicitly frozen three-file candidate. Backups precede mutation; existing source is restored from base with CRLF checks; new test is retained by rename; reinstatement validates the fresh baseline report and byte-exact candidate hashes.
preconditions: Candidate HEAD equals d78485bdd064028ed6add5fcdbb92789df474de0 and branch equals feature/anka-alert-history-20261013.
Frozen three source hashes match; index is empty; the new test is untracked; core.autocrlf is true.
All owned source paths resolve within the isolated candidate; roundtrip backup directory must not exist; primary preservation check succeeds.
No reviewer/test/helper is reading or writing candidate source during rollback, and no other writer changes the candidate.
Fresh baseline must be 19/19 with no failures, errors, skips or denied audited events, matching base hashes and starting after restoration.
Exact candidate reinstatement must be followed by the planned fresh targeted/Qt gate; frozen hashes and primary preservation must be rechecked.
limits: This is a source-file rehearsal, not rollback of a user SQLite database or a deployed application.
Writes are sequential, not atomic across all files; interruption can leave a partial phase. Preserve backups and inspect the recorded phase before recovery.
No rollback, reinstatement, baseline execution or post-reinstatement execution was performed by this reviewer.
Static helper review does not establish that rollback has succeeded; root owns actual execution and evidence.

declined_to_judge.scope: Performance with very large event/run histories
declined_to_judge.reason: No load requirement or benchmark was provided; the full cursor scan is reported as a nonblocking scalability limitation.

declined_to_judge.scope: Repair and validation of arbitrary hand-edited/corrupt database rows or imported backups
declined_to_judge.reason: Supported event writes validate prices and aware timestamps; this slice does not change backup validation or define a corruption-repair contract. History still assumes well-formed existing records; malformed-row hardening remains separate.
No concurrency behavior is introduced; existing SQLite check_alerts semantics are reused. The single-process manual workflow and same-process multiple store handles are covered.

declined_to_judge.reason: Reviewer is read-only; these root-owned operational gates were not executed by reviewer and must retain separate evidence.

assessment.reasoning: Reviewed source meets the stated local history/all-symbol manual refresh requirements without modifying existing alert crossing or paper-trade algorithms. The independently executed missing-context/history-limit probe passed on the frozen hashes, and author/root tests are separately attributed. This verdict does not replace rollback or full-product acceptance.
